summary: Immix Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting the termination of Richard Graydon as of July 17, 2026, for reasons unrelated to company activities. The filing emphasizes that due to his short tenure, management believes the departure has no material effect on the business. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. The event is a discrete management change, not part of a broader special situation. No structural details, collateral, or regulatory clocks are provided. Watch for any subsequent disclosures on replacement or operational impact.
